sim-highline audit packet

60 curves that were read from published figures, chosen by a fixed rule so that every simulation with such curves appears and relations are spread. For each: the curve as stored, six of its values, where it came from and the definitions recorded. Please look at the cited figure and tell us whether it is the right run and panel, whether the values agree to about 0.1 dex, and whether the definitions are right. Five minutes per curve is plenty; one curve is useful. Nothing here is a claim that the curves are correct: nobody who knows these simulations has checked them yet.

x: log10 halo mass (FOF) [log10(Msun)]
y: log10 median stellar-to-halo mass ratio, M*/Mh (converted from the plotted ratio normalised by Omega_m/Omega_b) [dex]
